segments.source: Seln Aru alesese traseul pentru că trenurile erau controlate de Vaor, iar galeriile de la est puteau fi prăbușite. Patru mii de agenți, tehnicieni și voluntari ai Casei Selc înaintau de-a lungul marginii înghețate a Dungii, protejați de costume termice și vehicule joase. Oficial, misiunea lor era restabilirea infrastructurii planetare. În inventar aveau tunuri de dispersie, spumă de imobilizare și suficientă veyrină pentru încă trei stații.
segments.translation: Seln Aru had chosen the route because Vaor controlled the trains and the eastern galleries could be collapsed. Four thousand agents, technicians and House Selc volunteers advanced along the Belt's frozen edge, protected by thermal suits and low vehicles. Officially, their mission was to restore planetary infrastructure. Their inventory included dispersal cannons, immobilising foam and enough veyrin for three more stations.

segments.source: Nu aveau experiență de luptă.
segments.translation: They had no combat experience.

segments.source: Nici Prima Față nu avea, dar supraviețuise unei încercări.
segments.translation: Neither did the First Face, but it had survived a trial.

segments.source: Taren alese să-i oprească la Lacul Surd, o depresiune acoperită de gheață poroasă, la douăzeci de kilometri vest de camerele locuite. Acolo, vântul din Noapte ștergea mirosurile, iar stratul de zăpadă ascundea gurile vechilor tuneluri geotermale. Oru cartografiase zona înainte să moară. Pe placa lui de lucru rămăseseră notate punctele unde căldura subterană subțiase gheața.
segments.translation: Taren chose to stop them at Deaf Lake, a depression covered in porous ice, twenty kilometres west of the inhabited chambers. There, the wind from the Night erased smells, and the snow hid the mouths of the old geothermal tunnels. Oru had mapped the area before he died. His working slate still marked the points where underground heat had thinned the ice.

segments.source: Taren ținea placa în palmă când Vessa veni lângă el.
segments.translation: Taren held the slate in his palm when Vessa came beside him.

segments.source: Purta armură din plăci de rădăcină întărită, prea mare pentru corpul ei. În ultimele zile mâncase puțin și vomitase de două ori în timpul antrenamentelor. Taren nu întrebase. Înaintea unei bătălii, corpurile aveau dreptul la propriile secrete.
segments.translation: She wore armour made of hardened root plates, too large for her body. In recent days she had eaten little and vomited twice during training. Taren had not asked. Before a battle, bodies had a right to their own secrets.

segments.source: — Sunt însărcinată, spuse ea.
segments.translation: “I'm pregnant,” she said.

segments.source: Vântul îi plie amândouă velele spre est.
segments.translation: The wind folded both her sails eastwards.

segments.source: Taren privi lacul.
segments.translation: Taren looked at the lake.

segments.source: — De cât timp știi?
segments.translation: “How long have you known?”

segments.source: — Dinaintea ceții.
segments.translation: “Since before the mist.”

segments.source: — De ce ai venit aici?
segments.translation: “Why did you come here?”

segments.source: — Pentru că sunt medic.
segments.translation: “Because I'm a doctor.”

segments.source: — Sunt alți medici.
segments.translation: “There are other doctors.”

segments.source: — Și pentru că vreau să văd ce fel de tată aleg înainte să-l las să devină poveste.
segments.translation: “And because I want to see what kind of father I'm choosing before I let him become a story.”

segments.source: Taren întoarse tot corpul spre ea.
segments.translation: Taren turned his whole body towards her.

segments.source: — Nu am nevoie de asta acum.
segments.translation: “I don't need this now.”

segments.source: — Exact acum ai nevoie. Dacă mori, copilul va fi crescut de cei care îți vor folosi moartea. Dacă trăiești, va fi crescut de ceea ce faci astăzi.
segments.translation: “Now is exactly when you need it. If you die, the child will be raised by those who use your death. If you live, it will be raised by what you do today.”

segments.source: — Îl poți pierde în frig.
segments.translation: “You could lose it in the cold.”

segments.source: — Tu poți pierde o mie două sute de persoane. Nu transforma grija în privilegiu numai fiindcă este a ta.
segments.translation: “You could lose twelve hundred people. Don't turn care into a privilege just because it's yours.”

segments.source: Îi luă placa din mână și indică două puncte.
segments.translation: She took the slate from his hand and pointed to two places.

segments.source: — Tunelurile acestea comunică. Dacă deschidem supapele, aburul va slăbi gheața sub flancul central.
segments.translation: “These tunnels connect. If we open the valves, the steam will weaken the ice beneath the central flank.”

segments.source: — Oru a marcat zona ca instabilă.
segments.translation: “Oru marked the area as unstable.”

segments.source: — De aceea va funcționa.
segments.translation: “That's why it will work.”

segments.source: Taren ar fi vrut să-i spună că nu alesese nimic din toate acestea. Că saryxul căzuse în fața lui, că Daran pusese armele la îndemână, că Seln trimisese gaz, că fiecare pas fusese un răspuns la ceva deja făcut. Dar copilul din imaginea Vessei transforma apărarea în scuză. Un viitor nu avea nevoie numai de explicația cauzelor; avea nevoie de cineva care să accepte că participase.
segments.translation: Taren wanted to tell her he had chosen none of this. That the saryx had fallen in front of him, that Daran had put weapons within reach, that Seln had sent gas, that every step had been a response to something already done. But the child in Vessa's picture turned defence into an excuse. A future needed more than an explanation of causes; it needed someone who accepted having taken part.

segments.source: — Dacă trăiesc, spuse, nu vreau ca Daran să-i dea nume.
segments.translation: “If I live,” he said, “I don't want Daran to name the child.”

segments.source: — Atunci trăiește suficient cât să te cerți cu el.
segments.translation: “Then live long enough to argue with him.”

segments.source: — Tu rămâi la punctul medical.
segments.translation: “You stay at the medical post.”

segments.source: — Voi rămâne unde pot salva cei mai mulți.
segments.translation: “I'll stay where I can save the most people.”

segments.source: — Este ordin.
segments.translation: “That's an order.”

segments.source: Vessa se apropie. Nu ridică vocea.
segments.translation: Vessa came closer. She did not raise her voice.

segments.source: — Ai spus că protecția nu este proprietate. Nu mă transforma în prima excepție.
segments.translation: “You said protection isn't ownership. Don't make me the first exception.”

segments.source: Taren își coborî privirea. Puterea era simplă când se îndrepta spre un dușman. Lângă cei iubiți, fiecare limită semăna cu posesia.
segments.translation: Taren lowered his gaze. Power was simple when directed at an enemy. Beside those he loved, every boundary resembled possession.

segments.source: — Atunci promite-mi că pleci dacă linia cade.
segments.translation: “Then promise me you'll leave if the line falls.”

segments.source: — Promit că decid când linia a căzut.
segments.translation: “I promise I'll decide when the line has fallen.”

segments.source: Era tot ce avea să primească.
segments.translation: It was all he would get.

segments.source: La trei kilometri spre vest, Aven Sor primea aceleași ore sub alt nume. Pentru armata centrală, noaptea dinaintea bătăliei era „faza finală de desfășurare a serviciilor”. Ordinele lui Seln evitau toate cuvintele militare. Agenții trebuiau să restabilească accesul, să izoleze elementele armate și să protejeze populația de escaladare.
segments.translation: Three kilometres to the west, Aven Sor received the same hours under a different name. For the central army, the night before the battle was “the final phase of service deployment”. Seln's orders avoided every military word. The agents were to restore access, isolate armed elements and protect the population from escalation.

segments.source: Pe hărți, Vaorul apărea ca o problemă de infrastructură înconjurată de civili.
segments.translation: On the maps, Vaor appeared as an infrastructure problem surrounded by civilians.

segments.source: Aven își așezase postul într-un vehicul de distribuție transformat. În jurul lui, ofițerii exersau traseele de dispersare, iar tehnicienii verificau tunurile de spumă. Majoritatea agenților purtau arme care imobilizau. Lamele termice erau sigilate pentru situații extreme. Cuvântul *extrem* nu avea criteriu comun.
segments.translation: Aven had set up his post in a converted distribution vehicle. Around him, officers rehearsed dispersal routes and technicians checked the foam cannons. Most agents carried weapons that immobilised. The thermal blades were sealed for extreme situations. The word *extreme* had no shared criterion.

segments.source: Iren Sol, tehnicianul de oglinzi, veni cu harta geotermală.
segments.translation: Iren Sol, the mirror technician, arrived with the geothermal map.

segments.source: — Traseul lacului nu este sigur, spuse.
segments.translation: “The lake route isn't safe,” he said.

segments.source: — Modelele îl dau stabil pentru greutatea noastră.
segments.translation: “The models show it as stable under our weight.”

segments.source: — Modelele centrale nu includ conductele locale. Există anomalii de temperatură sub gheață.
segments.translation: “The central models don't include local pipes. There are temperature anomalies beneath the ice.”

segments.source: — Cât de mari?
segments.translation: “How large?”

segments.source: — Nu știm. Vaorul a oprit senzorii.
segments.translation: “We don't know. Vaor switched off the sensors.”

segments.source: Aven mări imaginea. Ruta alternativă trecea printr-un defileu unde tunelurile puteau fi prăbușite. Lacul era deschis, vizibil și, potrivit tuturor simulărilor, permitea desfășurarea fără contact apropiat.
segments.translation: Aven enlarged the image. The alternative route passed through a gorge where the tunnels could be collapsed. The lake was open, visible and, according to every simulation, allowed deployment without close contact.

segments.source: — Custodele a aprobat traseul, spuse.
segments.translation: “The Custodian approved the route,” he said.

segments.source: — Custodele a aprobat modelul.
segments.translation: “The Custodian approved the model.”

segments.source: — Este aceeași decizie.
segments.translation: “It's the same decision.”
